newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares slip, seen testing resistance.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares slip, seen testing resistance.

text.p: Austrian shares drifted lower on Wednesday in meagre trade after a half-hearted attempt to break through resistance at 1,040 failed.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed to a high of 1,039.7 in early trade but eventually ended 2.35 points or 0.23 percent lower at 1,033.67.
Among its constituents, 14 fell while, five gained and two were unchanged.
"It was quiet across the board today, but at least we are not far off the 1,040 mark," one trader said.
Another said higher trading volumes were needed to break out of the narrow 1,020-1,040 point range of the past six weeks, but that it was now "a realistic goal".
Shares in VA Technologie initially jumped to 1,348 schillings after stronger-than-expected first half results, but then eased off to end 7.5 schillings higher at 1,338.
Traders said all eyes were now on VA Stahl and Flughafen, both due to post first half results later this week.
The leading gainer of the session was Mayr-Melnhof, which climbed 1.12 percent to 498.5 schillings. VA Stahl was the leading decliner, shedding 1.83 percent to end at 338.5 schillings.
The all-share Vienna bourse index slipped 0.20 percent to 403.68.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for September delivery were up 7.1 points at 1,029.1. -- Elizabeth Fullerton, Vienna newsroom +431 531 12257
